findings.clause: Zlotnik voted for the Police Reform Act (H.4011/S.2820, 2020) which created a statewide certification system for police officers, banned chokeholds, and limited qualified immunity in Massachusetts.

Hoyle's vote for HR 2925 (opening public lands to mining corporations) and her past support for the Jordan Cove LNG pipeline, framing continued fossil-fuel/mining expansion as incompatible with protecting federal lands and clean water — closer to halting new permits than to maintaining or expanding current production.
